title: Paccheri Pasta with Italian Sherry Cream Sauce
description: A creamy paccheri pasta dish with a rich Italian sherry flavor. This recipe serves 4 and can be prepared in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook paccheri pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat and add chopped onion. Cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add Italian sherry to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Remove skillet from heat and stir in heavy cream to prevent scorching.
Combine cooked paccheri pasta and sherry cream sauce in the skillet and toss to coat.
